SELECT tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptrd.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION, ftp.BASIS, ftp.TRADE_MARKET, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, ftp.VDATE, ftp.MDATE, ftp.TERM, ftp.TERM_TYPE, ftp.CALENDAR_ID, tpd.CCY, ftp.PRIN, ftp.M_INT_AMT, ftp.M_TRADE_AMT, ftp.INT_RATE * 100 rebackPrice,
ftp.ACT_CAP_DAYS, ftp.VPAY_DATE, ftp.MPAY_DATE,
tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, TPD.CHL_ID, TPD.FEE_AMT, TPD.TRADE_AMT, fpt.TYPE_6,
tpd.branch, tpd.regist_org
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptrd ON ptrd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON tpd.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp ON ( (tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND ftp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID) OR (tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03} AND ftp.FINPROD_ID = SUBSTR(tpd.TRADE_ID, 1, LENGTH(tpd.TRADE_ID)-1)) ) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON ( (tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND fpt.FINPROD_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID) OR (tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03} AND fpt.FINPROD_ID = SUBSTR(tpd.TRADE_ID, 1, LENGTH(tpd.TRADE_ID)-1)) ) AND fpt.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select t2.finprod_market_id bondCode, t2.finprod_id finprodId, t2.finprod_abbr bondAbbrName, nvl(t1.pledge_amt,0) pledgePrin, null as prin, t1.pledge_ratio*100 pledgeRatio from fin_deal_pledge t1 left join fin_product t2 on t1.pledge_finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t1.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and t1.branch =#{branch}
